description: A bearded man in a black cap and long black gown stands in a dark carved wooden pulpit, one fist raised, with a large open book resting on the pulpit ledge. Below him a crowd of plainly dressed listeners in headscarves, hoods and caps sits in wooden pews, lit by candles and a flaming torch held by one figure on the left; a man in the lower left foreground has his hands clasped in prayer. The setting is a stone church or hall with pointed Gothic arches, thick pillars and wall sconces. The painting is in a warm, dark, painterly oil style and runs edge to edge with no frame or border visible. No legible letters, numbers or signature; the book pages are blank to the eye. Nothing gory or nude.
